  "implementation_summary": "The implementation plan focuses on building a robust, scalable partner payout system that handles the complete lifecycle from initiation to processing. The core architecture centers on idempotent transaction handling to ensure financial integrity across retries, with a unified abstraction layer for payment methods (Stripe Connect, PayPal, stablecoin) to simplify future extensibility. Automated reminders are scheduled via cron jobs to proactively engage partners with pending payouts, reducing manual intervention. A recompute mechanism allows for reconciliation and correction of payout states based on historical data, which is essential for auditing and data integrity. The system integrates with the existing codebase by extending the partner profile API endpoints and leveraging existing cron infrastructure, maintaining the application's modular monolith structure while adding sophisticated financial processing capabilities. All changes are implemented within the constraints of the existing codebase, ensuring minimal disruption to other feature areas."
